verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ בַּבֹּ֜קֶר וַיִּסְע֣וּ מֵֽהַשִּׁטִּ֗ים וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ עַד־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן ה֖וּא וְכָל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּלִ֥נוּ שָׁ֖ם טֶ֥רֶם יַעֲבֹֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·kêm yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bab·bō·qer way·yis·‘ū mê·haš·šiṭ·ṭîm way·yā·ḇō·’ū ‘aḏ- hay·yar·dên hū wə·ḵāl bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yā·li·nū šām ṭe·rem ya·‘ă·ḇō·rū
verses.literal: Early the next morning Joshua got up and left Shittim with all the Israelites . . . They went as far as the Jordan . . . where they camped . . . before crossing over
verses.literalPt: LEVANTOU-SE, pois, Josué de madrugada, e partiram de Sitim, ele e todos os filhos de Israel; e vieram até ao Jordão, e pousaram ali, antes que passassem.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י מִקְצֵ֖ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַיַּעַבְר֥וּ הַשֹּׁטְרִ֖ים בְּקֶ֥רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî miq·ṣêh šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm way·ya·‘aḇ·rū haš·šō·ṭə·rîm bə·qe·reḇ ham·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: After three days the officers went through the camp
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu, ao fim de três dias, que os oficiais passaram pelo meio do arraial;

verses.original: וַיְצַוּוּ֮ אֶת־ הָעָ֣ם לֵאמֹר֒ כִּרְאֽוֹתְכֶ֗ם אֵ֣ת אֲר֤וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם וְהַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם נֹשְׂאִ֖ים אֹת֑וֹ וְאַתֶּ֗ם תִּסְעוּ֙ מִמְּק֣וֹמְכֶ֔ם וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֖ם אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw·wū ’eṯ- hā·‘ām lê·mōr kir·’ō·wṯ·ḵem ’êṯ ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm hal·wî·yim nō·śə·’îm ’ō·ṯōw wə·’at·tem tis·‘ū mim·mə·qō·wm·ḵem wa·hă·laḵ·tem ’a·ḥă·rāw
verses.literal: and commanded the people . . . When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God being carried by the Levitical priests you are to set out from your positions and follow it
verses.literalPt: E ordenaram ao povo, dizendo: Quando virdes a arca da aliança do SENHOR vosso Deus, e que os sacerdotes levitas a levam, partireis vós também do vosso lugar, e seguireis.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ׀ רָח֣וֹק יִהְיֶ֗ה בֵּֽינֵיכֶם֙ וּבֵינוֹ כְּאַלְפַּ֥יִם אַמָּ֖ה בַּמִּדָּ֑ה אַֽל־ תִּקְרְב֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו לְמַ֤עַן אֲשֶׁר־ תֵּֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽלְכוּ־ בָ֔הּ כִּ֣י לֹ֧א עֲבַרְתֶּ֛ם בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ מִתְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ rā·ḥō·wq yih·yeh bê·nê·ḵem ū·ḇē·nō kə·’al·pa·yim ’am·māh bam·mid·dāh ’al- tiq·rə·ḇū ’ê·lāw lə·ma·‘an ’ă·šer- tê·ḏə·‘ū ’eṯ- had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer tê·lə·ḵū- ḇāh kî lō ‘ă·ḇar·tem bad·de·reḵ mit·tə·mō·wl šil·šō·wm
verses.literal: But keep a distance . . . of about two thousand cubits . . . between yourselves and the ark Do not go near it . . . so that you can see the way to go since you have never traveled this way before . . .
verses.literalPt: Haja contudo, entre vós e ela, uma distância de dois mil côvados; e não vos chegueis a ela, para que saibais o caminho pelo qual haveis de ir; porquanto por este caminho nunca passastes antes.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶל־ הָעָ֖ם הִתְקַדָּ֑שׁוּ כִּ֣י מָחָ֗ר יַעֲשֶׂ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֖ם נִפְלָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’el- hā·‘ām hiṯ·qad·dā·šū kî mā·ḥār ya·‘ă·śeh Yah·weh bə·qir·bə·ḵem nip̄·lā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then Joshua . . . told the people Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you
verses.literalPt: Disse Josué também ao povo: Santificai-vos, porque amanhã fará o SENHOR maravilhas no meio de vós.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים לֵאמֹ֔ר שְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֔ית וְעִבְר֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַיִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֔ית וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’el- hak·kō·hă·nîm lê·mōr śə·’ū ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn hab·bə·rîṯ wə·‘iḇ·rū lip̄·nê hā·‘ām way·yiś·’ū ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn hab·bə·rîṯ way·yê·lə·ḵū lip̄·nê hā·‘ām
verses.literal: And he said to the priests . . . Take the ark of the covenant and go on ahead of the people So they carried the ark of the covenant and went ahead of them
verses.literalPt: E falou Josué aos sacerdotes, dizendo: Levantai a arca da aliança, e passai adiante deste povo. Levantaram, pois, a arca da aliança, e foram andando adiante do povo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה אָחֵל֙ גַּדֶּלְךָ֔ בְּעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר֙ יֵֽדְע֔וּן כִּ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיִ֛יתִי עִם־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶהְיֶ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh ’ā·ḥêl gad·del·ḵā bə·‘ê·nê kāl- yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer yê·ḏə·‘ūn kî ka·’ă·šer hā·yî·ṯî ‘im- mō·šeh ’eh·yeh ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: Now the LORD said to Joshua Today . . . I will begin to exalt you in the sight of all Israel so they may know that I am with you just as I was with Moses
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR disse a Josué: Hoje começarei a engrandecer-te perante os olhos de todo o Israel, para que saibam que, assim como fui com Moisés, assim serei contigo.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֗ה תְּצַוֶּה֙ אֶת־ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֥י אֲרֽוֹן־ הַבְּרִ֖ית לֵאמֹ֑ר כְּבֹאֲכֶ֗ם עַד־ קְצֵה֙ מֵ֣י הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן בַּיַּרְדֵּ֖ן תַּעֲמֹֽדוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh tə·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ- hak·kō·hă·nîm nō·śə·’ê ’ă·rō·wn- hab·bə·rîṯ lê·mōr kə·ḇō·’ă·ḵem ‘aḏ- qə·ṣêh mê hay·yar·dên bay·yar·dên ta·‘ă·mō·ḏū
verses.literal: Command the priests carrying the ark of the covenant . . . When you reach . . . the edge of the waters stand in the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Tu, pois, ordenarás aos sacerdotes que levam a arca da aliança, dizendo: Quando chegardes à beira das águas do Jordão, parareis aí.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל גֹּ֣שׁוּ הֵ֔נָּה וְשִׁמְע֕וּ אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl gō·šū hên·nāh wə·šim·‘ū ’eṯ- diḇ·rê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: So Joshua . . . told the Israelites . . . Come here and listen to the words of the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Então disse Josué aos filhos de Israel: Chegai-vos para cá, e ouvi as palavras do SENHOR vosso Deus.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ בְּזֹאת֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּן כִּ֛י אֵ֥ל חַ֖י בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְהוֹרֵ֣שׁ יוֹרִ֣ישׁ מִ֠פְּנֵיכֶם אֶת־ הַכְּנַעֲנִ֨י וְאֶת־ הַחִתִּ֜י וְאֶת־ הַחִוִּ֗י וְאֶת־ הַפְּרִזִּי֙ וְאֶת־ הַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֔י וְהָאֱמֹרִ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bə·zōṯ tê·ḏə·‘ūn kî ’êl ḥay bə·qir·bə·ḵem wə·hō·w·rêš yō·w·rîš mip·pə·nê·ḵem ’eṯ- hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥit·tî wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥiw·wî wə·’eṯ- hap·pə·riz·zî wə·’eṯ- hag·gir·gā·šî wə·hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·hay·ḇū·sî
verses.literal: He continued This is how you will know that the living God is among you and that He will surely drive out . . . before you the Canaanites Hittites Hivites Perizzites Girgashites Amorites and Jebusites
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Josué: Nisto conhecereis que o Deus vivo está no meio de vós; e que certamente lançará de diante de vós aos cananeus, e aos heteus, e aos heveus, e aos perizeus, e aos girgaseus, e aos amorreus, e aos jebuseus.

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֔ית אֲד֖וֹן כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ עֹבֵ֥ר לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם בַּיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ă·rō·wn hab·bə·rîṯ ’ă·ḏō·wn kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ ‘ō·ḇêr lip̄·nê·ḵem bay·yar·dên
verses.literal: Behold the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth will go ahead of you into the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Eis que a arca da aliança do Senhor de toda a terra passa o Jordão diante de vós.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה קְח֤וּ לָכֶם֙ שְׁנֵ֣י עָשָׂ֣ר אִ֔ישׁ מִשִּׁבְטֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֥ד אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֖ד לַשָּֽׁבֶט׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh qə·ḥū lā·ḵem šə·nê ‘ā·śār ’îš miš·šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl ’îš- ’e·ḥāḏ ’îš- ’e·ḥāḏ laš·šā·ḇeṭ
verses.literal: Now choose twelve . . . men from the tribes of Israel one . . . . . . . . . from each tribe
verses.literalPt: Tomai, pois, agora doze homens das tribos de Israel, de cada tribo um homem;

verses.original: וְהָיָ֡ה כְּנ֣וֹחַ כַּפּ֣וֹת רַגְלֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹשְׂאֵי֩ אֲר֨וֹן יְהוָ֜ה אֲד֤וֹן כָּל־ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ בְּמֵ֣י הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן מֵ֤י הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ יִכָּ֣רֵת֔וּן הַמַּ֥יִם הַיֹּרְדִ֖ים מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְיַעַמְד֖וּ נֵ֥ד אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kə·nō·w·aḥ kap·pō·wṯ raḡ·lê hak·kō·hă·nîm nō·śə·’ê ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh ’ă·ḏō·wn kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ bə·mê hay·yar·dên mê hay·yar·dên yik·kā·rê·ṯūn ham·ma·yim hay·yō·rə·ḏîm mil·mā·‘ə·lāh wə·ya·‘am·ḏū nêḏ ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: When the feet . . . of the priests who carry the ark of the LORD the Lord of all the earth touch down in the waters of the Jordan its flowing . . . waters will be cut off and will stand up in a heap
verses.literalPt: Porque há de acontecer que, assim que as plantas dos pés dos sacerdotes, que levam a arca do SENHOR, o Senhor de toda a terra, repousem nas águas do Jordão, se separarão as águas do Jordão, e as águas, que vêm de cima, pararão amontoadas.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּנְסֹ֤עַ הָעָם֙ מֵאָ֣הֳלֵיהֶ֔ם לַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים נֹֽשְׂאֵ֛י הָאָר֥וֹן הַבְּרִ֖ית לִפְנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bin·sō·a‘ hā·‘ām mê·’ā·ho·lê·hem la·‘ă·ḇōr ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm nō·śə·’ê hā·’ā·rō·wn hab·bə·rîṯ lip̄·nê hā·‘ām
verses.literal: So when the people broke camp . . . to cross the Jordan the priests carried the ark of the covenant ahead of them
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, partindo o povo das suas tendas, para passar o Jordão, levavam os sacerdotes a arca da aliança adiante do povo.

verses.original: וּכְב֞וֹא נֹשְׂאֵ֤י הָֽאָרוֹן֙ עַד־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וְרַגְלֵ֤י הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ נֹשְׂאֵ֣י הָֽאָר֔וֹן נִטְבְּל֖וּ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַמָּ֑יִם וְהַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן מָלֵא֙ עַל־ כָּל־ גְּדוֹתָ֔יו כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י קָצִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·ḇō·w nō·śə·’ê hā·’ā·rō·wn ‘aḏ- hay·yar·dên wə·raḡ·lê hak·kō·hă·nîm nō·śə·’ê hā·’ā·rō·wn niṭ·bə·lū biq·ṣêh ham·mā·yim wə·hay·yar·dên mā·lê ‘al- kāl- gə·ḏō·w·ṯāw kōl yə·mê qā·ṣîr
verses.literal: Now the Jordan overflows . . . . . . its banks throughout the harvest season But as soon as the priests . . . . . . carrying the ark reached . . . the Jordan and their feet touched the water’s edge
verses.literalPt: E quando os que levavam a arca, chegaram ao Jordão, e os seus pés se molharam na beira das águas (porque o Jordão transbordava sobre todas as suas ribanceiras, todos os dias da ceifa),

verses.original: וַיַּעַמְד֡וּ הַמַּיִם֩ הַיֹּרְדִ֨ים מִלְמַ֜עְלָה קָ֣מוּ נֵד־ אֶחָ֗ד הַרְחֵ֨ק מְאֹ֜ד בָאָדָם הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ מִצַּ֣ד צָֽרְתָ֔ן וְהַיֹּרְדִ֗ים עַ֣ל יָ֧ם הָעֲרָבָ֛ה יָם־ הַמֶּ֖לַח תַּ֣מּוּ נִכְרָ֑תוּ וְהָעָ֥ם עָבְר֖וּ נֶ֥גֶד יְרִיחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘am·ḏū ham·ma·yim hay·yō·rə·ḏîm mil·ma‘·lāh qā·mū nêḏ- ’e·ḥāḏ har·ḥêq mə·’ōḏ ḇå̄·ʾå̄·ḏå̄m hā·‘îr ’ă·šer miṣ·ṣaḏ ṣā·rə·ṯān wə·hay·yō·rə·ḏîm ‘al yām hā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh yām- ham·me·laḥ tam·mū niḵ·rā·ṯū wə·hā·‘ām ‘ā·ḇə·rū ne·ḡeḏ yə·rî·ḥōw
verses.literal: the flowing . . . water stood still It backed up . . . . . . as far upstream . . . as Adam a city in the area of Zarethan while the water flowing toward the Sea of the Arabah the Salt Sea . . . was completely cut off So the people crossed over opposite Jericho
verses.literalPt: Pararam-se as águas, que vinham de cima; levantaram-se num montão, mui longe da cidade de Adão, que está ao lado de Zaretã; e as que desciam ao mar das campinas, que é o Mar Salgado, foram de todo separadas; então passou o povo em frente de Jericó.

verses.original: וַיַּעַמְד֣וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹ֠שְׂאֵי הָאָר֨וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֜ה בֶּחָֽרָבָ֛ה בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן הָכֵ֑ן וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עֹֽבְרִים֙ בֶּחָ֣רָבָ֔ה עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר־ תַּ֙מּוּ֙ כָּל־ הַגּ֔וֹי לַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘am·ḏū hak·kō·hă·nîm nō·śə·’ê hā·’ā·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh be·ḥā·rā·ḇāh bə·ṯō·wḵ hay·yar·dên hā·ḵên wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl ‘ō·ḇə·rîm be·ḥā·rā·ḇāh ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- tam·mū kāl- hag·gō·w la·‘ă·ḇōr ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: The priests carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan while all Israel crossed over the dry ground until the entire nation had crossed the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Porém os sacerdotes, que levavam a arca da aliança do SENHOR, pararam firmes, em seco, no meio do Jordão, e todo o Israel passou a seco, até que todo o povo acabou de passar o Jordão.
